## Meshline\.Transport Namespace

| Classes | |
| :--- | :--- |
| [RelayClient](Meshline.Transport.RelayClient.md 'Meshline\.Transport\.RelayClient') | Sends HTTP and WebSocket protocol requests to one relay through an application\-owned relay pool\. |
| [RelayClientPool](Meshline.Transport.RelayClientPool.md 'Meshline\.Transport\.RelayClientPool') | Owns and shares relay clients for one network, account, and device, with separate account and device sessions\. |
